claim_review.avoid: Do not call the frozen-analyzer replay a second independently implemented tensor analyzer or a new training replication. The independent arithmetic audit is a separate piece of evidence.
claim_review.valid: 145 archived parts and 1289 restored members were independently byte-checked; a local rerun of the same frozen analyzer reproduces every scientific field exactly.

claim_review.avoid: Do not call the larger figure end-to-end inference, hardware energy, GPU, Transformer-relative or universal SNN speedup. Training-clock scope also includes registered gradient/probability checks.
claim_review.valid: Six fixed-update HCSN pairs show geometric training-clock speedup 1.9875431205 and whole-worker speedup 1.7430324100 on this CPU environment, with registered trajectory fidelity.

claim_review.avoid: Do not imply exactly equal whole-worker CPU. Validation, serialization, imports and setup are outside this training clock and separately measured; maximum training overrun is 0.383314056 seconds.
claim_review.valid: The 30-second clock covers minibatch sampling, forward/backward, finite/probability/gradient auditing, clipping and optimizer; final whole-update overrun is charged.

claim_review.avoid: Do not treat tokens, 70 jobs, six task-seed pairs, or observed checkpoints as 70 independent replicates. No confirmatory significance or statistical equivalence claim; shared test examples and three seeds limit generalization.
claim_review.valid: Primary means, sample SD and paired Student-t intervals describe three initialization/minibatch seeds conditional on the registered data split.

claim_review.avoid: Do not describe these as newly unseen test examples or fresh confirmatory holdout. README fresh-seed language refers to the initial registered seed choice, not new test independence in the hosted rerun.
claim_review.valid: All 70 hosted jobs were rerun, with no old-row substitution. This is an engineering replication after seven earlier local jobs already evaluated heldout data; CREMA-D heldout was observed earlier too.

claim_review.avoid: Do not conflate best validation checkpoint with the final 32-update tensor or claim bitwise equality where the registered test is numerical tolerance.
claim_review.valid: Full 32-update parameter and loss paths are the fidelity comparison. Validation-selected checkpoint test quality is a separate outcome.

claim_review.avoid: Do not report a matched-quality external speed advantage, or conclude universal architecture inferiority. The common learning rate, small models, length32 tasks and short budget do not optimize each architecture.
claim_review.valid: Zero of 18 prespecified external quality-conditioned comparisons qualifies. At equal training CPU, accelerated HCSN remains behind the strongest registered control on both primary tasks.

claim_review.avoid: Do not mislabel percentage-point gains as relative percentages or independent new-model quality gains. Both backends have identical trainable parameterization; extra completed updates are the engineering mechanism.
claim_review.valid: Copy and MQAR paired mean gains over HCSN reference are 13.73697917 and 16.89453125 percentage points at the fixed training-CPU budget.

claim_review.avoid: Do not infer general multimodal representation superiority, media decoding throughput, full-modality foundation-model ability or confidence intervals from these single-seed panels.
claim_review.valid: Irregular timing and CREMA-D are one-seed,16-update descriptive panels. CREMA-D uses fixed offline features, an already observed actor split and arithmetic late fusion.

claim_review.avoid: Do not add nested worker CPU, training clocks, analyzer-body clocks or native subprocess subtotals again. Unknown installation, publication-network and development costs stay unknown, not zero.
claim_review.valid: Choose the outer wait4 stage level plus that stage coordinator. Preserve earlier failed jobs and new replay costs separately. Replay is 5.047765481 CPU seconds; original hosted three-stage cost is unchanged.

claim_review.avoid: Do not turn classification gradients or native KEEP/STOP behavior into proof that the free boundary solves the task-optimal classification QVI.
claim_review.valid: The audit establishes reproducible computation and measured implementation acceleration. The affine regenerative stopping reward remains the registered local surrogate.

method: Stdlib independent recursive JSON comparison and byte hashing. The replay itself invokes the unchanged original analyzer; this review does not import it, train, select a new checkpoint, adjust a gate or alter scientific files.
statistical_and_cost_verdict: Reproducible engineering acceleration supported. No external quality-qualified speed win, fresh-holdout confirmation, multimodal foundation-model advantage, energy claim or task-optimal-boundary claim.
